title.narrative: Strengthening Pacific Intra-Regional and International Trade (SPIRIT)_PIFS

description.narrative: The General Objective of the SPIRIT is to boost and increase intra-regional and international trade of Pacific countries. The Specific Objective is to strengthen institutional and human capacity to boost Intra-Regional and international Trade. To achieve the objectives, SPIRIT will deliver the following Key Results: 1.Strengthening PACP governments trade and investment related institutions and human resource; 2.Strengthening capacity to implement EPA; 3.Coordination and implementation of Pacifics Aid-for-Trade strategy 2020-2025 in each PACP country; including peer learning and implementation of Pacific Quality Infrastructure Initiative and Ecommerce. 4.Development and integration of a statistical monitoring framework for Regional Economic Integration (REI)
